children: Hyperliquid adjusted testnet operation priorities following user feedback and added a CDeposit2 interface operation. According to ChainCatcher, noop and scheduleCancel no longer affect the priority of other operations, while operations other than noop, scheduleCancel, cancel, cancelByCloid, order, modify, and batchModify lower the priority of other operations until submission is complete. CDeposit2 works similarly to cDeposit but supports agent signatures.

title: Hyperliquid Revises Testnet Operation Priorities and Adds Agent-Signed CDeposit2
